purpose: Canonical KPI definitions for the NotebookLM uplift plan

theme_recall_at_20.description: Fraction of human-expected themes the pipeline surfaces in its top 20 by density

citation_grounding_rate.description: Fraction of claim-bearing sentences whose cited chunk_ids contain the claim's key entities + predicate within edit distance 15%

reproducibility_drift.description: Percentage of theme names that change across 5 consecutive runs with same corpus_hash + goal

time_to_first_theme.description: Seconds from collect-click to first theme rendered

provider_failover_p99.description: p99 latency added when primary provider 429s mid-pipeline

regression_policy.block_phase_advancement_when: any KPI regresses against the most recent baseline by > 2%
regression_policy.warn_phase_advancement_when: any KPI regresses against baseline by 0-2%
